text: How this reaches you. Written questions have asked which stage of interphase replication happens in, crediting the S phase or synthesis phase; one asked you to circle both interphase and S phase. Multiple-choice items track DNA mass or chromatid numbers round the cycle, and one question asked for the role of ATP in mitosis. The reject card keeps mitosis in its place. And the hook? Each daughter cell receives a full set of genetic information: the DNA is copied first, then shared between the two cells.
